beforePrint.text: if @@admin <> 1 if not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and (type = '' or exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and b.a_print = 1))) begin select '$NotAuthorize' as message return end select '' as message

beforeExport.text: if @@admin <> 1 if not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and (type = '' or exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and b.a_print = 1))) begin select '$NotAuthorize' as message return end select '' as message

beforeEvent_Grid_query.text: if @@admin <> 1 and exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller') if not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and a_view = 1)) begin select '$NotAuthorize' as message return end

beforeEvent_Grid_finding.text: if @@admin <> 1 and exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller') if not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and a_view = 1)) begin select '$NotAuthorize' as message return end

beforeVoucherEvent_Grid_query.text: if @@admin <> 1 if not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and a_view_all = 1)) begin set @filterKey = case when isnull(@filterKey, '') = '' then '' else @filterKey + ' and ' end + 'a.user_id0 in (select user_id from sysuserinfo where user_ref like ''@@userRef%'')' --'a.user_id0 = @@userId' end if 1 < (select count(1) from sysunit) begin select unit_id into #unitright from dbo.ISWIFTFunctionGetUnitIDRight(@@userId, @@admin, '') set @filterKey = case when isnull(@filterKey, '') = '' then '' else @filterKey + ' and ' end + 'a.unit_id in (select unit_id from #unitright)' end if exists(select 1 from sysrightstatus where ma_ct = '@@voucherCode' and user_id = @@userId and a_view = 1) begin set @filterKey = case when isnull(@filterKey, '') = '' then '' else @filterKey + ' and ' end + 'exists (select 1 from sysrightstatus sr where a.status = sr.ma_ttct and sr.ma_ct = ''@@voucherCode'' and sr.user_id = @@userId and sr.a_view = 0)' end

beforeVoucherEvent_Grid_finding.text: if @@admin <> 1 if not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and a_view_all = 1)) begin set @filterKey = case when isnull(@filterKey, '') = '' then '' else @filterKey + ' and ' end + 'a.user_id0 in (select user_id from sysuserinfo where user_ref like ''@@userRef%'')' end if 1 < (select count(1) from sysunit) begin select unit_id into #unitright from dbo.ISWIFTFunctionGetUnitIDRight(@@userId, @@admin, @ma_unit) set @filterKey = case when isnull(@filterKey, '') = '' then '' else @filterKey + ' and ' end + 'a.unit_id in (select unit_id from #unitright)' end if exists(select 1 from sysrightstatus where ma_ct = '@@voucherCode' and user_id = @@userId and a_view = 1) begin set @filterKey = case when isnull(@filterKey, '') = '' then '' else @filterKey + ' and ' end + 'exists (select 1 from sysrightstatus sr where a.status = sr.ma_ttct and sr.ma_ct = ''@@voucherCode'' and sr.user_id = @@userId and sr.a_view = 0)' end
